trickster.title: Trickster key points
items: For big pulls and boss burst, lay down {Cloud Cover} smoke with {Adrenaline Rush} and start inside it
When {Coup de Grace} is ready after 4 {Unseen Blade}, use it via {Dispatch}; with 2+ targets, use it with {Blade Flurry} active

fatebound.title: Fatebound key points
items: {Hand of Fate} coins are only flipped by finishers spent at 5+ combo points
When {Roll the Bones} rolls a high tier, extend it by 30 sec with {Keep It Rolling}

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Line up Feint (15 sec) with Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to everyone), and pop it again when Carrion Burst DoTs stack during Ssscavenging (Topicx)

[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on every Ssscavenging shield. Use Between the Eyes (45 sec) and Blade Rush (1 min) on every shield, and Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree (3 min) on a shield whenever they are back (Topicx)
[위치] Step on distant Messy Eater puddles with Sprint or Grappling Hook and return to the boss with Blade Rush
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Kick (15 sec) into the kick rotation for the three back-to-back Toxic Atrophy casts, and set the order in chat before the pull (Topicx)
[광역 피해] When Uncoil splits the boss into five Writhes, press Adrenaline Rush with Bloodlust and hit them together with Blade Flurry, Blade Rush, and Killing Spree (Topicx)
[제어] Stop a Writhe heading for the Spiteful Hunt target with Kidney Shot
Zul'jan: [위치] If your Ritual of the Fang beam spot is far, Sprint there before the channel, and pop Feint while you soak the beam. The beam-soak channel is also when the group uses its defensives (Topicx)
[참고] After clearing Ritual Venom with Boneslicer or a slowed Axegrinder axe (both armor-ignoring Physical), top yourself off with Crimson Vial (Topicx·Icy Veins)

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt (116379 Holy) does not need an interrupt rotation, so kick it whenever Kick (15 sec) is ready

[광역 피해] Standing in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam means taking 77586 Nature every 1 sec plus the beam's 77586 Holy every 2 sec, so go in with Feint (15 sec) up and top yourself off with Crimson Vial when the beam ends
[회피] If you are targeted by Thornblade, Sprint out of Fan Of Thorns' 15 yd range and come back with Blade Rush
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Bloodthorn Roots is a magic effect, so if you are rooted you can clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows

[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes out below 50% when there is no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase (Topicx), so line up Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree with it, and pop Feint for Thorncaller Roar (82435 Nature over 6 sec)
[회피] If you are the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, Sprint to open distance, and if Verdant Stomp knocks you back, return with Grappling Hook
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Kick in the interrupt rotation for Warden's Wrath (48491 Nature), which repeats on the tank during Moonkin Form

[참고] If you get a Pulverizing Strikes mark with Grievous Thrash bleed still on you, do not use Sprint or Grappling Hook; stand still, top yourself off with Crimson Vial, and pop Feint before the cones (164870 Physical every 2 sec) arrive
[광역 피해] Save Feint and Cloak of Shadows for Spirits of the Vale after 40%
Ziekket: [차단] Kick the pre-revive Lashers' Lightspore Shot, and if another one casts, stop it with Kidney Shot. Neither works on revived Lashers
[광역 피해] When the Lashers spawn, turn on Blade Flurry and cut them down together with Blade Rush

[참고] Backing up to the far right edge of the platform pulls an Overgrown Hydra, so do not Grappling Hook to that edge. If a pulled Hydra targets you with Lightmaw Beams, negate the damage with Cloak of Shadows or Vanish (Wowhead)

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Ravenous Bellow is AoE physical damage that ignores armor, so turn on Feint
[위치] If the Spoiled Supplies mushrooms are far, step on one and get back with Sprint or Grappling Hook
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Kick into the Winter's Shroud rotation for Fractured Shivercore, and if one is missed, stop it with Kidney Shot

[우선 처치] As melee, take the Fractured Shivercore next to the boss and match its health with the add the ranged are on so both die together. If you are on Rimeshatter soak duty after an add dies, get there within 6 sec with Grappling Hook (Topicx)
[해제] Glacial Torment is a magic effect, so you can clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] Pop Feint behind Zul'jarra's shield for Overwhelming Onslaught (armor-ignoring Physical to everyone, three hits 1 sec apart)
[위치] If you are targeted by Echoing Maul, Sprint to this set's assigned corner within 4 sec to drop the Echo, and take the 193965 Nature within 8 yd with Cloak of Shadows (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Echoing Fury (67888 Nature) while blocking Echoes during Fury of the War God. If Bloodlust was saved for this boss, line up Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree with it (Topicx)

Kystia Manaheart: [우선 처치] In the first Destabilized (20 sec, 115% more damage taken), stack Adrenaline Rush, Between the Eyes, Blade Rush, and Killing Spree on Kystia to take her to about 40%, and if cooldowns are short for the second window, reset them with Preparation (Topicx)
[차단] Kick your assigned Mirror Images copy, and stop another copy right away with Kidney Shot (Wowhead)
[해제] Corroding Spittle is a magic DoT, so you can clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] The fight starts with the worker pack after the RP, so line up Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree with the second Bloodlust and hit the workers and boss together with Blade Flurry (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Bladestorm (164870 Physical to nearby players every 0.5 sec)
[위치] Hide behind the nearest crate for Murder in a Row. Several players can share one crate, so there is no need to Sprint to a far one, and Sprint away before a hit crate explodes 5 sec later
Xathuux the Annihilator: [광역 피해] When Demonic Rage makes the boss take 30% more damage, line up Adrenaline Rush and Between the Eyes, and on the second Demonic Rage, where the third Bloodlust goes out, add Killing Spree too (Topicx)
[우선 처치] When the Axe Toss axe lands, keep Blade Flurry up and make the axe your primary target
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Infernal Crush
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Kick into the Chaos Bolt rotation and do not spend it on Wild Imp's Felfire Burst. Stop Felfire Burst casts you cannot kick with Kidney Shot

[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on the Vilefiend and Wild Imp spawns, not the boss. Line up Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree with the add spawns and kill them fast with Blade Flurry and Blade Rush (Topicx)

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Use Cloak of Shadows or Feint for the Dark Bloom shadow damage
[회피] After dodging the Void Fissure orbs, get right back on the boss with Grappling Hook or Blade Rush
Atroxus: [우선 처치] When a Toxic Creeper spawns, make it your primary target and let Blade Flurry carry damage onto the boss. Bloodlust goes out on the first Creeper, so line up Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree with it (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Monstrous Roar is AoE Physical damage, so pop Feint
Charonus: [광역 피해] Pop Feint for the Cosmic Crash explosion

[위치] If you are targeted by Gravitic Orbs, as melee Sprint the orb quickly to your assigned one of the two near Singularities, and pop Feint for the damage you take crossing the pools if it is back (Topicx)

The Golden Serpent: [제어] Kill the Animated Gold from Lucre's Call with Blade Flurry and Blade Rush, and stop the one closest to the boss with Kidney Shot
[광역 피해] Turn on Feint for Serpentine Gust
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Kick Wretched Discharge from Half-Finished and Finished Mummies, and stop the second mummy with Kidney Shot
[참고] If you are targeted by Drain Fluids, heal up with Crimson Vial to clear Desiccation quickly
[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes out on Mchimba, so pop Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree with it (Topicx)
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] The longer Kula lives, the more Whirling Axes pile up, so keep Blade Flurry up on the trash dragged in and stack Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree on Kula to kill her before the fourth set of axes (Topicx)
[차단] Put Kick into the rotation for Zanazal's Poison Nova, and if an Explosive Totem is far away, close in with Grappling Hook or Blade Rush and break it before Explode
[참고] Attacks that look physical, such as Kula's Severing Axe, can be stopped with Evasion (Wowhead)
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes out at the start of Dazar, so stack Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree on Reban and kill him before T'zala joins at 80%. On a four-Bloodlust route, reset them with Preparation for the phase 2 Bloodlust (Topicx)
[차단] Put Kick into the rotation for Reban's Deathly Roar
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for the Gilded Destruction burst, and ride out the 15 sec group DoT with Crimson Vial

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank interrupts Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands, so keep Kick as a backup in case the tank misses it (Topicx)
[해제] The intermission Infused Whelps' Cold Claws is a magic effect, so you can clear high stacks yourself with Cloak of Shadows

[광역 피해] Line up Adrenaline Rush and Between the Eyes with the 66% and 33% Ice Bulwark shield, and pop Feint for Frost Overload in this intermission, which is the heaviest group damage of the fight (Topicx)
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Kick into the Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley rotation
[광역 피해] Turn on Feint for the Firestorm's Inferno party damage
[위치] When the Firestorm casts Burnout as it dies, Sprint out beyond 20 yards, then return with Blade Rush
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [우선 처치] When Kyrakka lands, close in with Blade Rush and put in Adrenaline Rush and Between the Eyes

[광역 피해] If you are targeted by Inferno Spit, go to the edge on the side of the next Winds of Change and pop Feint the moment the 6 sec DoT ends in an 8 yd explosion. It explodes the moment the DoT is removed, so use Cloak of Shadows only after you reach the edge (Topicx)
[참고] If your cooldowns line up just before phase 2, keep Preparation to stack them once more in phase 2

Adderis & Aspix: [위치] When Storm Blessed moves, Blade Rush straight to the boss without immunity
[광역 피해] Pop Feint when you share Thunder and Lightning after the Gale Force knockback
[위치] The bosses stand in the middle of the room, so if Gale Force pushes you far away, get back into melee right away with Grappling Hook (Topicx)
Merektha: [광역 피해] Turn on Blade Flurry for the Hatch adds and put damage into the Storm Serpent, which has double health, first
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Serpentstorm (116379 Nature to the group plus an 8 sec DoT and knockback) (Topicx)
Galvazzt: [위치] Move quickly with Sprint during Lightning Spire beam swaps, and turn on Evasion while Galvanized increases your physical damage taken by 250%
Avatar of Sethraliss: [우선 처치] Put Adrenaline Rush and Between the Eyes into the Essence Defiler to kill it first, and in phase 2 lock down the healer-chasing Faithless Tormentors with Kidney Shot (Topicx)
[차단] Stuns do not work on the Twisted Hexxer, so you must Kick its Flame Shock (Method)
[위치] If you are a Corrupted Lifeforce soaker, Sprint to it before it bursts

454419.d: Sinister Strike generates 1 additional combo point when it grants Opportunity.

454435.d: Sinister Strike has 5% increased chance to strike an additional time and grant Opportunity and your Fatebound Coins flipped have an additional 5% chance to match the same face as the last flip.

408.m: 기력 25 / 연계 점수 1의 5점 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
408.d:
적에게 마무리 일격을 날려 기절시킵니다. 연계 점수에 따라 지속시간이 증가합니다. 최대 8초까지 증가합니다.
연계 점수 1점: 4초
연계 점수 2점: 5초
연계 점수 3점: 6초
연계 점수 4점: 7초
연계 점수 5점: 8초

1766.m: 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
1766.d: 날랜 발차기로 적을 가격하여 주문 시전을 차단하고, 대상이 6초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하는 것을 방해합니다.

1784.d: 그림자 속에 숨어 취소할 때까지 보이지 않는 상태로 적을 추적할 수 있습니다. [어둠의 집중: 은신 중에는 모든 능력의 자원 소모가 10%만큼 감소합니다] [잠행의 대가: 은신 중과 은신 후 5초 동안 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다]

1856.m: 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1856.d: 전투 중 시야에서 사라져 은신 상태를 취합니다. 소멸 사용 후 처음 3초 동안에는 피해를 입거나 해로운 효과가 적용되어도 은신이 해제되지 않습니다. 이동 방해 효과에서 벗어날 수 있습니다.

1966.m: 기력 35 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1966.d: 회피 동작을 취하여 광역 공격으로 받는 피해를 40%만큼 감소시킵니다. 6초 동안 지속됩니다.

2094.m: 특성 · 15 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
2094.d: 대상의 눈을 멀게 해 1분 동안 방향 감각을 상실하게 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 사라집니다. 한 번에 하나의 대상에게만 영향을 줍니다.

2098.m: 기력 35 / 연계 점수 1의 5점 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시

마무리 일격으로 적에게 연계 점수당 피해를 입힙니다.

연계 점수 3점: [(전투력의 61.16%) * 3]의 피해
연계 점수 4점: [(전투력의 61.16%) * 4]의 피해
연계 점수 5점: [(전투력의 61.16%) * 5]의 피해
[ 연계 점수 6점: [(전투력의 61.16%) * 6]의 피해]
[ 연계 점수 7점: [(전투력의 61.16%) * 7]의 피해]

2983.d: 8초 동안 이동 속도가 70%만큼 증가합니다. 은신 중에도 사용할 수 있습니다. [전력 질주: 물 위를 달릴 수 있습니다]

5171.m: 기력 25 / 연계 점수 1의 5점 · 100 야드 사정거리 · 즉시

연계 점수를 소비하여 공격 속도를 50%만큼, 기력 회복 속도를 15%만큼 증가시키는 마무리 일격을 시도합니다. 연계 점수에 따라 지속시간이 증가합니다.
연계 점수 1점: 12초
연계 점수 2점: 18초
연계 점수 3점: 24초
연계 점수 4점: 30초
연계 점수 5점: 36초 [심오한 책략: 연계 점수 6점: 42초]

8676.d:
적을 급습하여 (전투력의 278%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. [숨겨진 기회: 30%의 확률로 기회가 부여됩니다]

연계 점수 2점을 얻습니다.

13750.d: 15초 동안 기력 회복 속도가 75%만큼, 최대 기력이 50만큼, 공격 속도는 20%만큼 증가합니다.

13877.d: 주위에 있는 최대 5명의 대상을 공격해 (전투력의 153%)의 물리 피해를 입히고, 또한 10초 동안 단일 대상 공격 시 주위에 있는 최대 4명의 적을 추가로 공격해 일반 공격력의 28%에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다.

14161.d: 마무리 일격 사용 시 소모한 연계 점수 1점당 20%의 확률로 연계 점수 1점을 얻습니다.

31224.d: 모든 해로운 주문 효과를 즉시 제거합니다. 또한 망토는 5초 동안 모든 해로운 주문에 저항하도록 합니다.

31230.d: 죽음에 이르는 치명적인 공격을 받았을 때, 죽는 대신 전체 생명력의 7%만큼 생명력이 보존되고, 3초 동안 받는 모든 피해가 85%만큼 감소합니다. 이 효과는 6분에 1번씩만 발동됩니다.

51690.m: 특성 · 기력 45 / 연계 점수 1의 7점 · 8 야드 사정거리 · 집중 · 3 분 재사용 대기시간
51690.d:
총격을 무차별적으로 난사하는 마무리 일격을 날립니다. 8미터 내 무작위 적을 공격해 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 연계 점수에 따라 공격 횟수가 증가합니다.

0.50초마다 연계 점수 1점을 생성합니다. [심오한 책략: 7]5점을 초과하여 소모한 연계 점수 1점당 공격력이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

연계 점수 1점: 0.50초에 걸쳐 [((전투력의 225%) + (전투력의 225%)) * 2]의 피해
연계 점수 2점: 1.00초에 걸쳐 [((전투력의 225%) + (전투력의 225%)) * 3]의 피해
연계 점수 3점: 1.50초에 걸쳐 [((전투력의 225%) + (전투력의 225%)) * 4]의 피해
연계 점수 4점: 2.00초에 걸쳐 [((전투력의 225%) + (전투력의 225%)) * 5]의 피해
연계 점수 5점: 2.50초에 걸쳐 [((전투력의 225%) + (전투력의 225%)) * 6]의 피해
[ 연계 점수 6점: 3.00초에 걸쳐 [((전투력의 225%) + (전투력의 225%)) * 7]의 피해]
[ 연계 점수 7점: 3.50초에 걸쳐 [((전투력의 225%) + (전투력의 225%)) * 8]의 피해]

57934.m: 특성 · 100 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
57934.d: [도둑의 배짱: 대상의 공격력이 15%만큼 증가하고]자신이 생성하는 위협 수준이 모두 대상 파티원 또는 공격대원에게 이전됩니다. 30초 이내에 실시하는 자신의 다음 공격으로부터 시작되며, 6초 동안 지속됩니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

79096.d:
마무리 일격 사용 시 소모한 연계 점수당 여러 도적 능력의 남은 재사용 대기시간이 1.0초만큼 감소합니다.

영향을 받는 능력: 아드레날린 촉진, 미간 적중, 폭풍의 칼날, 질풍 칼날, 갈고리 던지기, 도박의 연속, 광기의 학살자, 뼈주사위, 전력 질주. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

114018.d: 장막을 펼쳐 30미터 내의 파티 및 공격대원을 어둠으로 감싸 최대 15초 동안 은신 상태로 만듭니다.

185311.d: 연금술 혼합물을 마시고 자신의 최대 생명력의 20%를 4초에 걸쳐 회복합니다.

185763.d:
감췄던 권총을 뽑아 적을 향해 재빨리 사격해 [(전투력의 83.4%) * [(전투력 * 0.98)][((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3)] -- 2H, DW / 전투력]의 물리 피해를 입히고, 6초 동안 대상의 이동 속도를 30%만큼 감소시킵니다.

연계 점수 1점을 생성합니다.

193315.d:
적을 매섭게 공격해 [(전투력의 122.3%) * ((최대(0, 최소(90 - 10, 10)) * 8 + 195) / 275)]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. [기회: 30%의 확률로 적을 한 차례 더 공격하고, 다음 권총 사격에 소모되는 기력이 30%만큼 감소하며, 공격력은 30%만큼 증가합니다]

적중할 때마다 연계 점수 1점을 얻습니다.

195457.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능

196938.d: 기회가 권총 사격의 공격력을 20%만큼 추가로 증가시킵니다. 권총 사격으로 소모한 기회 중첩 하나당 연계 점수 1점을 생성합니다.

200733.d: 실명의 재사용 대기시간이 50%만큼, 지속시간이 70%만큼 감소하고 주위의 모든 적에게 부여됩니다.

256170.d: 아드레날린 촉진 활성화 시 다음 뼈주사위의 결과가 1단계 향상됩니다.

271877.m: 특성 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
271877.d:
칼을 빼들고 대상에게 돌진하여 주 대상에게 [(전투력의 375.3%)% * 230 / 100]의 물리 피해를 입히고, 주위 모든 적에게는 (전투력의 375.3%)%의 피해를 입힙니다. 8%명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

폭풍의 칼날이 활성화된 동안에는 주 대상이 아닌 대상에게 입히는 피해가 100%만큼 증가합니다.

5초에 걸쳐 25의 기력을 생성합니다.

279876.d:
사악한 일격이 30%의 확률로 추가로 적중하고 기회를 부여합니다.

기회
다음 권총 사격에 소모되는 기력이 50%만큼 감소하며, 공격력은 100%만큼 증가합니다.

280716.d: 치명독에 생기흡수 효과를 더해, 생기흡수가 3.0%만큼 증가합니다.

315341.m: 기력 25 / 연계 점수 1의 5점 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
315341.d:
적에게 권총으로 마무리 일격을 날려 물리 피해를 입히고 공격력을 4%만큼 증가시킵니다. 이 추가 효과는 여러 번 중첩될 수 있습니다.

연계 점수 2점: [((전투력의 75.1%) * ((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3) / 전투력) * 2]의 피해, 6초
연계 점수 3점: [((전투력의 75.1%) * ((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3) / 전투력) * 3]의 피해, 8초
연계 점수 4점: [((전투력의 75.1%) * ((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3) / 전투력) * 4]의 피해, 10초
연계 점수 5점: [((전투력의 75.1%) * ((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3) / 전투력) * 5]의 피해, 12초
[ 연계 점수 6점: [((전투력의 75.1%) * ((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3) / 전투력) * 6]의 피해, 14초]
[ 연계 점수 7점: [((전투력의 75.1%) * ((전투력 + 보조 무기 전투력) * 2 / 3) / 전투력) * 7]의 피해, 16초]

315508.d: 운명의 주사위를 굴려 30초 동안 무작위 전투 능력을 강화합니다.

315584.d: 무기에 1시간 동안 유지되는 치명독을 바릅니다. 매 공격 시 30%의 확률로 적을 중독시켜 즉시 (전투력의 7.4%)의 자연 피해를 입힙니다. (효과 발동 확률: 30%)

381623.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간 · 3회 사용 가능
381623.d:
100의 기력을 회복합니다.

기력이 30 미만으로 떨어지면 엉겅퀴 차를 마십니다.

381637.d: 무기에 1시간 동안 유지되는 비치명독을 바릅니다. 매 공격 시 30%의 확률로 적을 중독시켜 1분 동안 공격력을 (4 *- 1)%만큼 감소시킵니다. (효과 발동 확률: 30%)

381828.d: 미간 적중 사용 시 소모한 연계 점수당 3%의 확률로 연계 점수 4점을 부여하고 재사용 대기시간이 초기화됩니다.

381846.d:
기회가 부여되면 추가로 1번 중첩됩니다. 최대 6번까지 중첩됩니다.

권총 사격 사용 시 기회 1중첩을 추가로 소모하여 탄환 1발을 추가로 발사합니다. 추가 사격은 20%만큼 감소된 피해를 입힙니다. (500밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

381989.d: 활성화된 뼈주사위의 전투 강화 효과의 남은 지속시간이 30초만큼 증가합니다.

394321.d:
최대 연계 점수가 1점만큼 증가합니다.

연계 점수 5점 이상을 소모하는 마무리 일격의 효과가 증가하고, 마무리 일격이 5%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

441146.d:
사악한 일격 및 매복 사용 시 추가로 무형검을 구사해 (전투력의 280%)의 피해를 입힙니다. 적중당한 대상은 10초 동안 당혹 상태가 됩니다.

당혹 상태인 적은 시전자에게 받는 피해가 5%만큼 증가하고 시전자의 공격을 무기로 막지 못합니다.

이 효과는 20초에 한 번씩만 발동합니다.

(750밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

441273.d: 연계 점수를 생성하는 공격이 당혹 상태인 대상에 대한 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 50%만큼 증가합니다.

441274.d: 광기의 학살자의 재사용 대기시간이 10%만큼 감소하며, 다음 2회의 무형검이 재사용 대기시간을 무시하도록 합니다.

441321.d: 무형검 및 광기의 학살자가 12초 동안 마무리 일격의 공격력을 4%만큼 증가시킵니다. 최대 5번까지 중첩됩니다.

441403.d: 속임수 거래의 위협 전환 지속시간이 1시간으로 증가합니다.

441423.d: 무형검으로 4번 공격한 후에 다음 속결을 최후의 일격으로 사용해 연계 점수 5점을 추가로 소모한 것과 같은 효과를 발휘하도록 합니다. 추가로 무결한 형상 5중첩을 얻습니다.

441429.d:
아드레날린 촉진 활성화 시 6초 동안 연막을 생성합니다. 연막 범위 안에서 공격 시 당혹 상태를 부여하며, 추가로 최대 1번까지 중첩됩니다.

이 효과는 연막을 벗어난 후에도 6초 동안 지속됩니다.

452536.d:
마무리 일격으로 연계 점수를 5점 이상 소모할 때마다 운명결속 동전을 던집니다. 앞면이 나오면 15초 동안 혹은 뒷면이 나올 때까지 공격으로 입히는 피해가 10%만큼 증가합니다. 뒷면이 나오면 대상에게 (전투력의 168%)의 우주 피해를 입힙니다.

연속으로 같은 면이 나올 때마다 앞면은 공격력이 추가로 2%만큼, 뒷면은 입히는 피해가 10%만큼 증가합니다. (200밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

453428.d: 속결로 운명결속 동전을 던질 때 지난 던지기 시도와 같은 면이 나올 확률이 33%만큼 증가합니다.

454286.d: 피해를 받을 때 30%의 확률로 받은 피해의 10%를 흡수합니다.

454419.d: 사악한 일격 사용 시 기회가 부여되면 연계 점수 1점을 추가로 생성합니다.

454435.d: 사악한 일격의 추가 공격이 발동하고 기회를 부여할 확률이 5%만큼 증가합니다. 또한 운명결속 동전을 던질 때 이전 시도와 같은 면이 나올 확률이 5%만큼 증가합니다.

470347.d:
아드레날린 촉진 사용 시 연계 점수 1점이 과충전됩니다.

공격 마무리 일격을 사용하면 과충전된 연계 점수를 소모하여 연계 점수 2점을 추가로 소모한 것과 같은 효과를 발휘합니다.

1248970.d:
동전을 7번 던질 때마다 12초 동안 운명을 자신에게 유리한 방향으로 비트는 행운 주화를 갖습니다. 민첩성이 4%만큼, 운명결속 동전의 공격력과 추가 효과가 50%만큼 증가하며, 동전을 던질 때 지난 던지기 시도와 같은 면이 나올 확률이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

행운 주화를 보유한 동안에는 동전을 던져도 행운 주화 발견에 반영되지 않습니다.

1259469.d: 폭풍의 칼날이 공격 시 주위 적에게 적중하여 일반 공격력의 8%에 해당하는 추가 피해를 입히도록 합니다.

1259485.d: 자동 공격이 치명타 및 극대화로 적중하면 다음 미간 적중의 공격력과 치명타 및 극대화율이 2%만큼 증가하며, 최대 20번까지 중첩됩니다.

1265863.d: 속결 사용 시 소모한 연계 점수 1점당 12%의 확률로 탄환을 숨깁니다. 6발의 탄환을 숨기면 다음 미간 적중 사용 시 숨긴 탄환을 소모하며 기력을 소모하지 않고 연계 점수 6점을 생성하며, 추가로 재사용 대기시간이 즉시 초기화됩니다. (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1276626.d: 당혹 상태가 받는 피해를 3%만큼 추가로 증가시킵니다.

1277933.d: 즉시 아드레날린 촉진, 미간 적중, 폭풍의 칼날, 질풍 칼날, 광기의 학살자의 재사용 대기시간을 초기화합니다.

1: [차단] Take one of the two interrupt slots that keep Radiant Spellsower walking toward the tank, and kick Light Bolt Volley (174568 Holy, 4 sec cast) with Kick (15 sec, melee).

[광역 피해] Once everything is gathered and Bloodlust goes out, use Adrenaline Rush (3 min) and Blade Rush with Blade Flurry active, and follow Adrenaline Rush with Killing Spree (3 min). The Trickster build starts the fight inside the Cloud Cover smoke. Pop Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec).

[제어] If a low-health Radiant Spellsower runs off with Call The Grove, catch it with Grappling Hook or Blade Rush and hold it with Kidney Shot (30 sec, 8 sec stun at 5 combo points) before Frantic Blooming (8 sec channel).
2: [우선 처치] When a Lightgorged Lasher wraps itself in the Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108), target it and break the shield with Between the Eyes and Dispatch. It is immune to crowd control while shielded, so Kidney Shot and Blind will not work.
[차단] One Kick (15 sec) cannot cover both Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley, so Kick one and stop the other's cast with a Kidney Shot stun or hand it to another interrupter.
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Spouting Floret, and top yourself off with Crimson Vial (30 sec, heals 20% of max health over 4 sec) afterward.
3: [제어] With 12 Lashers in this pull, a Radiant Spellsower fleeing with Call The Grove is dangerous. If Kidney Shot is back, follow it with Grappling Hook, stun it, and kill it right away.
[위치] If Virid Grovekeeper's Uproot (116379 Nature) knocks you back, return to melee right away with Blade Rush (20 yd) or Grappling Hook so your Blade Flurry damage does not drop.
5: [광역 피해] This is the first big pull after the boss, so use Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree on the Sporeblight Belcher pulled first, and if both are on cooldown, reset them with Preparation (4 min). Pop Feint for Spouting Floret.
[차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast, 3 sec disorient).
[제어] Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap (193965 Physical frontal cone with knockback every 2 sec for 6 sec) can be stopped with a stun (Topicx), so stop it with Kidney Shot.
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech. If Kick is free, also kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot.
[제어] When the two Thorny Saptors start Thornclaw Leap, stop one with Kidney Shot (30 sec) and hand the other to a party member with a stun. Kidney Shot only stuns a single target.

[참고] While the five Spineshield Beetles still have Spiny Shield (absorbs 500090), your Blade Flurry extra hits also strike them and each hit reflects 4849 Nature back to you. Top yourself off with Crimson Vial if your health drops.
8: [광역 피해] Pop Feint for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and top yourself off with Crimson Vial afterward.
[제어] Stop one of the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Kidney Shot, and when you have room, kick the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot with Kick.
10: [위치] Potatoad Matriarch is pulled the moment you cross a certain spot on the floor, so do not cross that spot with Grappling Hook, Sprint, or Blade Rush while clearing the Lasher adds.

[광역 피해] Clear the Lasher pack with Blade Flurry and save Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree for the Potatoad Matriarch you engage afterward. Pop Feint for Toxic Spew (2 sec cast, 67888 Nature to the party plus a 9 sec poison), and if Feint is not up, use Cloak of Shadows (2 min) during the cast to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.
11: [제어] One Kick (15 sec) cannot cover all three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech, so Kick one and Kidney Shot another, and if all three cast together, stop them with Blind (1 min with Airborne Irritant, hits all nearby enemies). Blind can break on damage.
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.
12: [광역 피해] This is the last big pull, so use Adrenaline Rush, Killing Spree, and Blade Rush, and if Preparation is up, cycle them once more. If Spouting Floret and Light Bolt Volley (both Holy) overlap, use Cloak of Shadows (2 min) instead of Feint to resist spell damage for 5 sec.
[우선 처치] Among the six Lightgorged Lashers, target the ones wrapped in the Lightbloom Pollination shield and break it with Between the Eyes and Dispatch. Shielded ones are immune to crowd control.
[차단] Put Kick in the interrupt rotation for the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley, and hold one that flees with Call The Grove using Kidney Shot.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical) with Kick (15 sec).

[광역 피해] This is the first pull, so once the mobs are gathered, use Adrenaline Rush (3 min) and Blade Rush with Blade Flurry active and follow with Killing Spree (3 min). The Trickster build starts the fight inside the Cloud Cover smoke.
[해제] Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every sec for 20 sec, 10% slow per tick) is a magic effect, so you can clear it yourself with Cloak of Shadows (2 min).
2: [우선 처치] Make Ritual Chieftain your primary target and focus Between the Eyes and Dispatch on it. Let your Blade Flurry extra hits handle the Ravenous Descendants.

[광역 피해] Pop Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) for Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group plus a 162029 heal absorb), and burn through the remaining heal absorb with Crimson Vial (30 sec, heals 20% of max health over 4 sec).
3: [차단] When the three Primal Serpents walk down behind the pillar, Kick one, and if interrupts run short, stop another with Kidney Shot (30 sec, 8 sec stun at 5 combo points).
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Blood Sacrifice and clear the heal absorb with Crimson Vial afterward.
4: [우선 처치] Line up Between the Eyes and Blade Rush (1 min) on the Ritual Chieftain to kill it before several Blood Sacrifices land, and pop Feint for Blood Sacrifice.
[차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Kick.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 103 trash. Use Adrenaline Rush, Blade Rush, and Killing Spree and melt the Ritual Chieftain first. If both are on cooldown, reset them with Preparation (4 min).
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Blood Sacrifice, and when the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots DoTs stack up, clear them with Cloak of Shadows.
7: [차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast), and break Evolve (6 sec channel) with a Kidney Shot stun to deny the shield and crowd-control immunity.
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Rattling Writhe's Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec).
8: [광역 피해] Pop Feint for Rattle and top yourself off with Crimson Vial afterward. If you are standing in a blood pool near the four Bloodletters, get out by Blade Rushing to another target.
9: [우선 처치] Kill the two pulled-in High Evolutionists before the second Mass Envenom. Kick the closer one's Mass Envenom and break Evolve with Kidney Shot.
11: [차단] Kick your assigned High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom, and if another one channels Evolve, break it with Kidney Shot. Kick (15 sec) and Kidney Shot (30 sec) cannot cover all four, so split interrupt duty beforehand.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so line up Adrenaline Rush, Killing Spree, and Between the Eyes on this mini-boss.
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for the 8 yd 69827 Nature burst when Infest expires, and heal through the 5 sec DoT (34914 Nature every sec) with Crimson Vial.
13: [우선 처치] Make Ula'tek's Chosen your primary target, and with six Living Venoms in the pack, do not use Killing Spree (hits random enemies within 8 yd) or Blade Rush. Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so save Kick for the Chosen.
[광역 피해] Take Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec) with Feint (6 sec), and cover the last 3 sec with Cloak of Shadows (resists harmful spells for 5 sec).
[제어] During Toxic Surge, stun one Blade of the Altar with Kidney Shot to stop its Laced Edge teleport.
14: [제어] If the Kidney Shot (30 sec) used on pull 13 is back, stun a Blade of the Altar again during Toxic Surge.
[광역 피해] If you used Cloak of Shadows (2 min) on pull 13, survive Toxic Surge with Feint and Crimson Vial. Kick Mass Envenom.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Kick.
[해제] When Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots DoTs stack up, clear them with Cloak of Shadows.
16: [우선 처치] Stack Adrenaline Rush, Killing Spree, and Blade Rush on Ula'tek's Chosen to kill it before the second Toxic Surge. If they are short, reset them with Preparation. Kick the Chosen's Mass Envenom.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back, so pop Feint (15 sec) for each, and use Cloak of Shadows when Toxic Surge overlaps. If your health drops, clear the heal absorb with Crimson Vial.

1: [우선 처치] This is the Bloodlust pull. Bribed Captain dies first, so stack Adrenaline Rush (3 min), Between the Eyes, and Killing Spree (3 min) on the Captain. The Trickster build starts the fight inside the Cloud Cover smoke (Topicx).
[참고] The Captain's Deep Corruption cuts nearby mobs' AoE damage taken by 25%, so focus single-target damage on the Captain rather than Blade Flurry extra hits until it dies.
[참고] If Row Hooligan's Cutpurse hits you (38793 Physical plus 155172 bleed over 8 sec), top yourself off with Crimson Vial (30 sec, heals 20% of max health over 4 sec).
2: [차단] Seductive Sayaad's Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) needs one interrupter per Sayaad, so Kick (15 sec) your assigned one and stop it with Kidney Shot (30 sec) if interrupts run short (Topicx).
[회피] Felwyrms explode for 193965 Fire within 4 yd when they die, so keep Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) up while you Blade Flurry next to low-health Felwyrms.
3: [광역 피해] Killing all six Felwyrms at once with Blade Flurry sets off their Fel Detonations together in melee, so pop Feint while you hit them.
[차단] Kick Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles channel when Kick is free.
4: [참고] When the four Street Sneaks' Heartstop Poison stacks lower your max health, top yourself off with Crimson Vial, and Kick Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles.
5: [우선 처치] Line up Between the Eyes and Blade Rush (1 min) on Massive Felwyrm and kill it first. Over-infused deals 38793 Fire within 50 yd every 3 sec, so pop Feint (Topicx).
[회피] When Massive Felwyrm dies and casts Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd), Sprint out past 10 yd.
8: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and crowd-control immunity for 1 min). Hand Fel Invoker's Health Funnel to another interrupter.
[회피] When Shivan Punisher starts Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yd), walk out past 12 yd and come back with Blade Rush.
[우선 처치] Once the Punisher drops below 50% and Demonic Frenzy starts pulsing Fire damage every sec, stack Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree on it and kill it fast (Topicx).
9: [참고] If Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life targets you, press Cloak of Shadows (2 min, resists harmful spells for 5 sec) or slip out of it by going into stealth with Vanish (2 min). Taking it lets the Warlock heal a lot (Topicx).
[차단] Kick one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage and stop the other with Kidney Shot. Once Fel Rage lands, crowd control no longer works.
[우선 처치] When the Warlock shields itself with Dark Pact at 50%, break it with Between the Eyes and Dispatch.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel (Topicx).
[우선 처치] Once Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, stack Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree to kill it fast, and step out past 12 yd during Whirlwind before returning with Blade Rush.
11: [광역 피해] Stack Adrenaline Rush, Killing Spree, and Between the Eyes on Felmaster Lucsei so its Blade Dance (Fire to the whole group) does not come out more than three times (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Pop Feint (15 sec) for Blade Dance, and if Feint is not back, take it with Cloak of Shadows. Splitting your personals this way keeps them from overlapping with group defensives (Topicx).
13: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage first, and only kick Unleashed Imp's Felfire Burst when Kick is free.
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to everyone), and step away from the Defiled Detonation spots that follow. Dodge Fel Beam by walking backward (Topicx).
14: [차단] Between the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage and Fel Invoker's Health Funnel, take Fel Rage with Kick first and stop the second Fel Rage with Kidney Shot.
[광역 피해] Clear the six Unleashed Imps at once with Blade Flurry and Blade Rush.
15: [참고] The Corrupted Warlock gets dragged back and killed first, so if Drain Life targets you, use Cloak of Shadows or Vanish. If you used Cloak of Shadows (2 min) on pull 9, keep Vanish for this (Topicx).
[우선 처치] Kill Shivan Punisher separately and stack Blade Rush and Between the Eyes into its sub-50% Demonic Frenzy window.
16: [우선 처치] Stack Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree on Defiled Golem so it dies within two of its AoE casts, and if both are on cooldown, reset them with Preparation (4 min) (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for the first Defiled Slam and Cloak of Shadows for the second. Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel.

1: [광역 피해] This pull gets the first Bloodlust and cooldowns. Once the mobs are gathered, use Adrenaline Rush (3 min) and Blade Rush with Blade Flurry active and follow with Killing Spree (3 min). The Trickster build starts the fight inside the Cloud Cover smoke (Topicx).
[우선 처치] When the Starvation Effigy totem goes up, switch to it and break it with Between the Eyes and Dispatch before it applies Insatiable Hunger twice.
[광역 피해] Pop Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) for Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec).
2: [차단] Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) and Earth Bolt (116379 Nature) both need stopping, so Kick (15 sec) one and stop the next cast with Kidney Shot (30 sec, 8 sec stun at 5 combo points).
[우선 처치] Break the Starvation Effigy totem before the second Insatiable Hunger cast, and pop Feint for Feast of Misery.
3: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze, and stop Earth Bolt with a stun if Kidney Shot is back.
[우선 처치] Break the Starvation Effigy totem first, and pop Feint for Feast of Misery.
4: [우선 처치] Break the Starvation Effigy totem first, and pop Feint for Feast of Misery.

[참고] When the three Keen-Eyed Strikers dive in with Razor Dive and the bleed (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec) stacks up, top yourself off with Crimson Vial (30 sec, heals 20% of max health over 4 sec).
5: [차단] While the tank drags this pack to the boss spot, Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss, so use Adrenaline Rush, Killing Spree, and Blade Rush, and if both are on cooldown, reset them with Preparation (4 min) (Topicx).
[차단] Kick one of the two Earthwhisper Tenders' Healing Breeze, and stop the other with Kidney Shot or hand it to another interrupter.
8: [우선 처치] While Terra Rumbler holds its Rumbling Ward shield, the whole group takes 24246 Nature every 2 sec, so switch to it and break the shield with Between the Eyes and Dispatch. If your health drops, use Feint and Crimson Vial.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull. Line up Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree with Bloodlust, and reset them with Preparation if they are on cooldown (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% Haste and movement speed reduction on hit). If both cast together, stop the other one with Kidney Shot.
[우선 처치] Break Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield with Between the Eyes and Dispatch.
10: [차단] Kick one of the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar and stop the other with Kidney Shot. The 3.5 sec cast leaves time to react (Topicx).
[광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust, so use Blade Rush and Between the Eyes on cooldown, and if Preparation is still up, cycle Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree once more.
11: [우선 처치] Kill Avatar of Determination first, then Terra Rumbler. If Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree are back, line them up on the Avatar (Topicx).
[회피] When Pulverize starts (4 sec cast, stun and 387930 Physical within 12 yd), walk out past 12 yd, and return with Blade Rush (20 yd) when the cast ends.
13: [차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, up to 3 targets) with Kick.
[우선 처치] When Ruthless Totemcaller drops a Magma Totem (36368 Fire to the whole group every 0.3 sec), switch to it and break it right away.
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo (stacking armor-ignoring Physical AoE) (Topicx).
14: [우선 처치] Break the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems as soon as they go up. Caster attacks and totem damage overlap (Topicx).

[광역 피해] This is a candidate for the third Bloodlust. If Bloodlust goes out, line up Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree, and if the group saves Bloodlust for Loa Speaker Nanea on high keys, save your cooldowns too (Topicx).
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers take turns casting Primal Echo, so pop Feint (15 sec) for each Echo and top yourself off with Crimson Vial in between. Primal Echo is Physical damage that Cloak of Shadows cannot stop, so do not sit on Feint (Topicx).
[차단] Kick one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning and stop the other with Kidney Shot.
[우선 처치] This is a big pull at 85 trash, so use whatever Adrenaline Rush, Killing Spree, and Blade Rush you have left, and break Magma Totems as soon as they go up.
16: [차단] Put Kick into the interrupt rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt.

[우선 처치] When the three Volatile Totems go up, switch to them with Blade Flurry active unless Nanea is around 10% health. The goal is to finish within the second wave. If Bloodlust goes out here on high keys, line up Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree (Topicx).

1: [광역 피해] This pull takes the first corridor up to Voidtouched Magi in one go with Bloodlust. Once everything is gathered in the room, use Adrenaline Rush (3 min), Blade Rush, and Killing Spree (3 min) with Blade Flurry active, and the Trickster build starts inside the Cloud Cover smoke (Topicx).

[차단] Split interrupts beforehand. Take one Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Kick (15 sec), or take the second interrupt on Magi's Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd) (Topicx).

[광역 피해] If you are the Null Eruption target (145474 Shadow within 10 yd plus a 5 sec DoT), move out of the group with Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) up, and on high keys take it with Cloak of Shadows (2 min) (Topicx).
2: [우선 처치] When Raj'kess the Spellstorm summons three Orbs of Disruption, switch right away. Reach the orbs with Grappling Hook or Blade Rush, and hit a far one with Between the Eyes (20 yd). If even one cast finishes, the group's Haste drops sharply (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Thundering Storm's long group damage, and cover the rest with Cloak of Shadows (resists harmful spells for 5 sec) (Topicx).
3: [광역 피해] This is the biggest room at 158 trash. When Brutok slams into a wall and gets Concussion (5 sec stun, 20% more Physical damage taken), stack Between the Eyes, Blade Rush, and Killing Spree on Brutok. All three of these Outlaw abilities deal Physical damage. If cooldowns are short, reset them with Preparation (4 min) (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Pop Feint (6 sec) for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature every 2 sec for 10 sec), and cover the remaining 4 sec with Cloak of Shadows (Topicx).
[우선 처치] If Angry Krolusk casts Violent Sand from far away (3 sec cast, 155172 Nature to the group and a 40% slow), close in with Grappling Hook and kill it fast (Topicx).
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important interrupt in this area, so save Kick for it and stop it with Kidney Shot (30 sec) if it is missed (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Pop Feint when you stand in Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike (5 sec cast) circle to share it, and step out of the leftover whirlwind right after the knock-up. If you are the Void Beam target, leave the group and top yourself off with Crimson Vial (Topicx).
6: [우선 처치] When Brutal Overseer raises its Brutal Slams shield, stack Adrenaline Rush, Between the Eyes, and Blade Rush to break it fast, and kill it before the next shield. Each slam gets 10% stronger until the shield breaks (Topicx).
[광역 피해] When Brutal Slams (Physical to the group every 1.5 sec) overlaps the Sky Strike soak, pop Feint, and keep moving with Sprint if you are the Macestorm target.
8: [우선 처치] This is a cooldown pull. When Devouring Brutalizer starts Devour (9 sec cast, heals itself 50%), switch at once to the marked low-health mob and kill it with Between the Eyes and Dispatch before the cast ends (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek. Kick Voidminder's Mending Void only when Kick is free (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Dreadbellow (knockback and 29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, not dispellable), and if the DoT lingers, top yourself off with Crimson Vial (30 sec, heals 20% of max health over 4 sec).
9: [광역 피해] Clear the ten gathered Scavenging Siphoids at once with Blade Flurry and Blade Rush. Keep Killing Spree for the Devour target.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek, and hand Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt to another interrupter or stop it with Kidney Shot. When Devour starts, switch to the marked mob at once (Topicx).
10: [우선 처치] This is the last big pull at 117 trash. Kill the Devour target first, use your remaining Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree on the Watchful Harrower that joins once the Brutalizer is nearly dead, and reset them with Preparation if they are on cooldown (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Alternate Feint between Dreadbellow and the Sky Strike soak, and use Cloak of Shadows when Feint is not up.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first pull of the dungeon, so Bloodlust goes out here. Drag the two Animated Guardians to the Shadow-Borne Champion pack, and once everything is gathered use Adrenaline Rush (3 min), Blade Rush, and Killing Spree (3 min) with Blade Flurry active. The Trickster build starts inside the Cloud Cover smoke (Topicx).

[광역 피해] Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yd) needs a defensive on every cast. Take the first cast with Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) and the next one with Cloak of Shadows (2 min, resists harmful spells for 5 sec) (Topicx).
[제어] Lock down the Minion of Zul on the way with Kidney Shot (30 sec, 8 sec stun at 5 combo points) to help purge its Bound by Shadow shield (Topicx).
2: [차단] Kick (15 sec) Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse DoT), and Kick Shadowfrost Bolt too when Kick is back.

[광역 피해] This corner pack is a separate cooldown pull (Topicx). If the Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree you used on pull 1 are still on cooldown, reset them with Preparation (4 min) and pour them into the Shadow-Borne Champion. Pop Feint for Shadow Whirlwind, or Cloak of Shadows if Feint is on cooldown.
4: [차단] Put Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (10 sec charm) and Soul Bolt, and Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending into the Kick rotation. Delay Guard Captain Atu's Captain's Bulwark (nearby mobs take 30% less damage) with Kidney Shot (Method).

[광역 피해] Until the tank has grabbed the awakened pack, do not jump in with Blade Rush and hold Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree (Topicx). Save the big cooldowns for the hardest pack, King A'akul and the Bloodsworn Assassins (Topicx).

[회피] When King Timalji's Bladestorm (164870 Physical every 0.5 sec) comes your way, leave with Sprint (2 min, 70% movement speed for 8 sec), and pop Evasion (2 min, 100% dodge for 10 sec) if you are late. Evasion likely works on anything that looks physical in this dungeon (Wowhead). If Sudden Rupture's bleed lands on you, top yourself off with Crimson Vial (30 sec).
5: [광역 피해] Pop Feint for every Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole group) from the Purification Construct, and take the next hit with Cloak of Shadows if the healer cannot keep up (Topicx).

[참고] If your route uses Bloodlust here on a high key, line up Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree with the Purification Construct. Clear the Embalming Fluids dragged in near the end together with Blade Flurry and Blade Rush (Topicx).
6: [차단] Assign two interrupts to the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, a 12 sec disease on the whole group) (Topicx). Kick one, and if both cast together, stop the other with Kidney Shot.
7: [차단] Kick one Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge, and if both cast together, stop the other with Kidney Shot (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Kill the eight Embalming Fluids at once with Blade Flurry and Blade Rush while dodging the Putrid Seekers pools.
9: [우선 처치] Kill the two Spectral Shamans first so no more Healing Tide Totems come out (Topicx). Put Between the Eyes and Dispatch into the Shamans with Blade Flurry active.

[차단] The two Phantom Hex Priests cast Spectral Bolt and Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph) nonstop (Topicx). Kick one and Kidney Shot the other, and if they stand together and cast at the same time, stop both with Blind (all nearby enemies with Airborne Irritant, 1 min cooldown).
[회피] Royal Berserker's Violent Lunge (394238 Physical) and Bloodthirsty Axe bleed are physical, so Evasion likely works on them (Wowhead). Top yourself off with Crimson Vial when the bleed stacks.
10: [광역 피해] On a four-Bloodlust route, the third Bloodlust goes out on this pack on the bridge (Topicx). Line up Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree with the Ghostly Brute, and if a Shaman is killed first, put Between the Eyes into that Shaman.

[회피] Melee must always escape Ghostly Brute's Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby plus a knock-up), so get out with Sprint. Pop Evasion if you are late (Wowhead: Evasion for physical attacks).
[차단] Kick Phantom Hex Priest's Spectral Bolt and Hex, and stop it with Kidney Shot when Kick is on cooldown.
12: [위치] Shadow of Zul's Shadow Barrage (58190 Shadow plus a 4 sec DoT) goes to whoever engages first, so do not open on it with Blade Rush, Grappling Hook, or Between the Eyes before the tank is on it (Topicx).
[광역 피해] If you are the Dark Revelation target (473120 Shadow within 20 yd after 5 sec), move away from the group with Sprint and pop Cloak of Shadows right before it goes off.

1: [우선 처치] Kill the CC-immune Primal Juggernaut first (Topicx). Once everything up to the entrance corridor is gathered, put Adrenaline Rush (3 min), Between the Eyes, and Killing Spree (3 min) into the Juggernaut with Blade Flurry active, and pop Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) for Excavating Blast (106681 Nature to the group plus an 8 sec DoT).
[제어] When Deepstone Earthshaper's Tectonic Strike stacks get high on the tank, the Earthshaper gets stunned (Topicx). Save Kidney Shot (30 sec, 8 sec stun at 5 combo points) for that Earthshaper.
[차단] Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield (15 sec channel, a shield and CC immunity every 3 sec) must be interrupted, so use Kick (15 sec) on that channel. Kick Frostbolt only when Kick is free.
2: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield. Touching an egg in the water spawns Infused Whelps that stack Cold Claws, so do not dive at mobs by the pools with Grappling Hook or Blade Rush (Topicx).
3: [광역 피해] The CC-immune mini-boss Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage deals 24246 Fire to the whole group on each hit, six times over 3 sec. Pop Feint on every cast, and put Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree into Draghar to kill it fast.
[제어] Kick the Chillweaver's Ice Shield so it does not land on Draghar, and Kidney Shot an Earthshaper when the tank's Tectonic Strike stacks get high (Topicx).
5: [차단] Spend Kick on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt first, and break Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel, cannot be interrupted) with Kidney Shot. A long channel kills the group (Topicx). If both Flamelashers channel together, stop both with Blind (all nearby enemies with Airborne Irritant, 1 min cooldown).

[광역 피해] Pop Feint for the CC-immune Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (96982 Fire to the group plus a 5 sec DoT), and leave the 20 yd Burnout explosion at once with Sprint (2 min) when the Destroyer dies.
6: [우선 처치] Below 50%, the CC-immune Flamegullet's Molten Blood group damage grows by 15% with each cast. Line up Adrenaline Rush and Killing Spree with the sub-50% window to shorten it, and pop them together with Bloodlust if it goes out at 50% on +17 and above (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Cinderbolt and break Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Kidney Shot. Keep Feint up while Molten Blood stacks.
7: [차단] Kick Cinderbolt, and break the two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage with Kidney Shot and Blind. Pop Feint for Inferno, and leave Burnout with Sprint when the Destroyer dies.
8: [차단] Kick Cinderbolt and break Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Kidney Shot.
[위치] Thunderhead patrols near this pack, so do not dive toward its path with Grappling Hook or Blade Rush. Afterward, go past on the side without the Thunderhead (Topicx).
10: [광역 피해] Clear the six Storm Warriors at once with Blade Flurry and Blade Rush, and pop Feint when Thunderous Stomp (53340 Nature within 60 yd) overlaps. The next Flamelasher pack is pulled right after the Channeler dies, so keep Blade Flurry up (Topicx).

[참고] If you are the target of Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec), pop Cloak of Shadows (2 min, resists harmful spells for 5 sec) and ride out the rest with Crimson Vial (30 sec) (Topicx). Feint does not reduce this single-target channel.
[제어] Break Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Kidney Shot. Stuns do not work on the CC-immune Tempest Channeler.
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt, and ride out Lightning Torrent with Cloak of Shadows or Crimson Vial if you are the target. This stretch is pulled without stopping, so keep up with Sprint (Topicx).
12: [우선 처치] When the CC-immune mini-boss High Channeler Ryvati raises Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of max health), a 60 yd 4 sec stun goes off if it expires unbroken. Stack Between the Eyes, Blade Rush, and Killing Spree to break the shield, and pop Adrenaline Rush with Bloodlust if your group lusts Ryvati on high keys (Topicx).
[광역 피해] While the shield is up the whole group takes 29095 Nature every sec, so pop Feint, and use Cloak of Shadows if you are the Lightning Torrent target (Topicx).

1: [우선 처치] Kill the CC-immune Sandfury Stonefist first (Topicx). Once the mobs are gathered, put Adrenaline Rush (3 min), Between the Eyes, and Killing Spree (3 min) into the Stonefist with Blade Flurry active.

[차단] Put the three Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt (116379 Nature) into the Kick (15 sec) rotation, and do not miss a Lightning Bolt kick when Ground Pound (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical within 60 yd plus knockback) goes off (Topicx). Pop Feint (15 sec, 40% less AoE damage for 6 sec) for Ground Pound.

[제어] If you break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel, 43642 Physical every 0.8 sec) with Kidney Shot (30 sec), it will not recast for a while. If it targets you, take it with Evasion (2 min) or Vanish (2 min) (Wowhead).
2: [위치] A Shrouded Fang hides below the stairs, so do not run ahead with Grappling Hook or Blade Rush until the tank engages (Topicx). Kick Poisoned Cheap Shot (2.5 sec cast from stealth, 5 sec stun and 96982 Nature every sec).
[우선 처치] Put Between the Eyes and Blade Rush into the Stonefist and pop Feint for Ground Pound. Break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Kidney Shot (Wowhead).
4: [우선 처치] Sand-Sworn Rider summons adds with Swarming Krolusks, so do not leave it up; stack Adrenaline Rush and Between the Eyes to kill it first (Topicx). Scouring Sand (4.5 sec cast, 290947 Nature frontal plus a 4 sec disorient) comes about 5 sec after the pull, so hit the Rider from the side or behind.
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt and break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Kidney Shot.
5: [차단] A Lightning Bolt on someone hit by a Krolusk charge or Cytotoxin kills them (Topicx). Put the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt into the Kick rotation and break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Kidney Shot.

[광역 피해] When the Sand-Sworn Rider joins from the bridge, use Killing Spree on the Rider and hit the Barbed Krolusk adds with Blade Flurry (Topicx). If a Serrated Charge bleed or Cytotoxin DoT lands on you, ride it out with Crimson Vial (30 sec).
6: [차단] One person is enough for Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast, 5 sec disorient) (Topicx). If it is yours, Kick it, and Kick Brood Tender's Venom Bolt (116379 Nature) once Kick is back or stop it with Kidney Shot.
7: [차단] Kick Brood Tender so Venom Bolt does not land on top of Cytotoxin poison (Topicx). Break Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Kidney Shot.
[우선 처치] Only one Sand-Sworn Rider comes in, so kill it first with Between the Eyes and Blade Rush to cut down the Swarming Krolusks adds (Topicx).
9: [광역 피해] Pop Feint for every Release Charge (3 sec cast, 145474 Nature to the whole group) from the Agitated Nimbus. When the two Nimbi's Release Charges come back to back, take the second with Cloak of Shadows (2 min, resists harmful spells for 5 sec) (Topicx).
[차단] Hold Kick so no Imbued Stormcaller Lightning Bolt slips through while the group is taking AoE damage (Topicx).
[우선 처치] The Loose Sparks orbs stop only once the Spark Channeler dies (Topicx). Dodge Loose Sparks (290947 Nature plus a 6 sec stun), then reach the Channeler with Grappling Hook or Blade Rush.
10: [차단] Stop the two Imbued Stormcallers before gathering the other mobs (Topicx). Kick one and stop the other with Kidney Shot.

[광역 피해] This dangerous pull calls for a potion or defensive (Topicx). Pop Feint for Release Charge, take the next one with Cloak of Shadows, and kill the four Static Anomalies together with Blade Flurry.
12: [제어] The Temple Disruptor on the far side of the orb gets crowd-controlled (Topicx). Use Blind (1 min cooldown and 18 sec disorient with Airborne Irritant) on the far Disruptor, and Kick the tank-side Disruptor's Essence Disruption channel to protect the orb charge.

[광역 피해] Pop Feint for Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature within 60 yd plus a 10 sec DoT). The second Loose Sparks stretch before this one one-shots DPS, so do not rush; dodge it, then hit the Spark Channeler (Topicx).
13: [제어] Lock the far Temple Disruptor with Blind if it is back, otherwise with Kidney Shot, and Kick the tank-side Disruptor (Topicx). Pop Feint for Caustic Stomp.
14: [차단] The CC-immune Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire plus an 8 sec DoT) cannot be stopped with a stun, so you must Kick it (Method).
[제어] The four Faithless Tormentors chase only the healer, so lock one down with Kidney Shot; everyone else can stand on them, so kill them together with Blade Flurry (Topicx).

[위치] If you are the Latent Hex target (a 4 sec Shadow DoT), leave the group. The hex explodes within 10 yd and leaves Hex Muck the moment it is removed, so if you clear it with Cloak of Shadows, do so only after leaving the group.
